verdict.rationale: Rootly documents an official MCP server that exposes incident data and actions to MCP clients and lets agents "take action". It also has a documented REST API with API keys, an OpenAPI spec, a changelog listing incident endpoints, and API-based incident creation. However, nothing in the pack shows acknowledge, escalate, or resolve operations through the API or MCP. Those three actions are only documented in Microsoft Teams and Slack, which are chat surfaces rather than a programmatic agent path. Missing for 10: explicitly documented API/MCP endpoints or tools for acknowledging, escalating, and resolving incidents or alerts; any hands-on or independent evidence of an agent running the full lifecycle without the dashboard.
